div.div:
dē-frŭor , frui,
I.v. dep., to use up, consume by enjoying: “auctumnitate,” Symm. Ep. 3, 23 ; cf.: defrui dicebant antiqui ut deamare, deperire, significantes omnem fructum percipere, Paul. ex Fest. p. 70, 14 Müll.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
